Title: General availability: New API version and .NET SDK for Azure Search

Body.Content:
API version 2016-09-01 and a new version of the .NET SDK are generally available for Azure Search. These updates include support for the blob indexer, table indexer, custom analyzers, Analyze API, and ETag. A new .NET Management SDK for Azure Search is also available.

To learn more about new features, read the announcement on the Azure blog. To learn more about Azure Search, see the What is Azure Search? documentation page.
